covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Edinburgh Waverley, Haymarket and Slateford, from the UK's national real-time feed.

covered.label: Edinburgh Trams
covered.detail: 21 tram stops between Edinburgh Airport and Newhaven, live predictions only - a tram only appears once the operator's real-time feed is confirming it, never filled in from the printed timetable.

notCovered.label: Trams at Haymarket and Edinburgh Gateway
notCovered.detail: Trams at Haymarket and Edinburgh Gateway aren't shown yet; their rail departures are.

notCovered.label: Caledonian Sleeper
notCovered.detail: Excluded at Edinburgh Waverley - booking a berth is compulsory.

stations: 58 stations and stops: 37 National Rail stations across Edinburgh and the Lothians, plus 21 stops on the Trams line from Newhaven to the Airport.
notes: Trams at Haymarket and Edinburgh Gateway aren't shown yet; their rail departures are. There is no Waverley tram stop, so for Waverley use the rail station.
